segments.mature: Reviewers using the cream for post-menopausal or aging skin, most in their 50s and 60s, report firmer, more toned skin, faded age spots, and softer fine lines with continued use alongside the companion serum.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including several in dry climates or cold winters, report the cream restores lasting moisture and leaves skin soft rather than tight.
segments.sensitive: The one reviewer with very sensitive skin reports the rich texture doesn't irritate her or cause puffiness around the eyes.

concerns.dehydration: The great majority of reviewers, most with dry or post-menopausal dry skin, report the cream restores lasting moisture and a plumper, softer feel, often within one to two weeks; a couple of reviewers used it for only two weeks and had not yet noticed a difference.
concerns.aging: Many reviewers report firmer, smoother-looking skin and softer fine lines and wrinkles after two or more weeks of use alongside the companion serum; a few reviewers using the cream alone for a few weeks say they saw no noticeable firming or wrinkle change.

aspects.libelle: Too heavy or greasy for daytime or under makeup
No SPF despite being marketed as a day cream
A little goes a long way
Absorbs faster than its rich texture suggests

extraits.texte: The scent of this product is so unpleasant and overwhelming. It does not go away either. It's unusable on the face for this reason. It's thick and creamy. So much so that many people would find it too heavy and greasy to use. I live in a dry climate too and still find it very heavy. It works somewhat but nothing earth shattering. I used it on my knees and thighs in the end because that's the only way I could tolerate the smell. It did make my legs look nicer lol. I'm 50 years old for reference. 65 and older crowd might have a different take on this product. It could be amazing for more mature skin than mine.

I was excited to see how the Vichy Neovadiol Replenishing Firming Day Cream would work under makeup. Typically I only do face creams at night. I did my morning face routine and then applied the cream. The cream is thick and hydrating. It absorbed fairly quickly and didn't add much wait time to my skin routine. I applied my make up over the cream and my skin wasn't greasy. The make up didn't settle into the cream and slide off. Instead, it made my skin look brighter. Since I have dry skin (especially in the winter), I have been happy to see my face looking fresher and not dry. The vitamins and Niacinamide have been good for my skin. The cream didn't cause me to breakout either. I do notice a softening of my fine lines. The only thing I wasn't a fan of is the scent. It is strong. The scent didn't go away as the day went on. I could still smell the cream. That took a little getting used to. I will continue to use the cream because I feel the benefits outweigh that minor inconvenience.

extraits.titre: Leaves my skin dewy and soft.
extraits.texte: I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review. I have been using this about once a day for 3 weeks. My skin is extremely dry, so I like that this is moisturizing. This leaves my face so dewy and soft. It takes a few minutes to soak in, but I apply my foundation before this completely soaks in. It is thicker than I thought it would be, so a tiny amount goes a long way. This jar will probably last a full year. (Reminds me of a cold cream that my grandmother used to use. That's not a bad thing.) I haven't used it long enough to notice any long term changes, but I like it so far. My foundation looks much better after using this. I am not sure if this would be good for someone with oily skin, but definitely good for my dry skin.

I got VICHY Neovadiol Replenishing Anti-sagginess Day cream in exchange of my honest opinion. After menopause my skin changed and it was dry and deep wrinkles started to show. This VICHY Neovadiol Replenishing Anti-sagginess Day cream and VICHY Neovadiol bi-serum combined are gold for my skin. First I apply the Bi-serum and I follow up with the cream. Now my skin feels softer and I think that I look a little bit younger because my deep wrinkles are a little less visible probably because my skin is more hydrated and moisturized. This is the first time I use VICHY products but it will not be the last time. I recommend both products together because you get better results but you can use them separately. I recommend it for people with dry skin or post menopause women that need to moisturize and hydrate their skin. They also help to reduce the appearance of wrinkles.

extraits.titre: Finally a product I can use.
extraits.texte: Love how thick and creamy this product is. With very sensitive skin is is great to find a product that doesn't irritate or cause the skin around my eyes to become puffy.

extraits.texte: Vichy Neovadiol Replenishing Firming Day Cream targets mature skin, but can easily be used by any skin type. It has a rich creamy texture, is non-greasy and glides on smoothly. Since it absorbs quickly, I kept wanting to apply more but that's not necessary - A little goes a long way, so use sparingly. I noticed how the hydration level of my skin changed within days after using it. After 2 weeks, my fine lines were greatly diminished, heavier lines not as deep, age spots had faded, eye bags weren't as prominent and my face was more toned. I feel that I now have a brighter appearance giving me a healthier glow. This is one of the best moisturizers I have used to date. Had I been aware of Vichy I would have used it in my younger years. This day cream would be appropriate for any skin, not only peri/post menopausal women. I have been given a boost of confidence. I will continue to use this product! I found by using Vichy's serum and facial cream together, my wrinkles were diminished, age spots were not gone but had faded, my face was more toned with a brighter appearance.
